findings.title: Metric hook removes negatives and duplicate hits, inflating precision and ranking scores
findings.observed: For [irrelevant, relevant], all six reported retrieval scores were 1. Expected precision/MRR/MAP=.5 and NDCG=1/log2(3). Duplicate relevant hits were removed, shifting later ranks. Nil hits and extra passages without corresponding PIDs panicked.
findings.fix: Map arbitrary original PIDs to compact positive identities; reserve zero for misses. Allocate one predicted ID per ranked slot, including nil/empty/unmatched and duplicate hits. Retain existing calculator duplicate handling. Guard mismatched passage indexing.
findings.tests: 13 hand-derived hook table cases cover negatives, duplicate hits/GT, zero/negative/max IDs, nil/empty hits and lists, mismatched arrays, rerank precedence and absent GT.

findings.title: Empty successful rerank reused the rejected search candidates
findings.observed: Reranking all candidates out still scored the relevant pre-rerank result as a perfect hit.
findings.fix: Only nil rerank results fall back to search; explicit empty rerank remains empty. Confirmed actual reranker uses a nonnil empty result for all_below_threshold and the QA pipeline turns ErrSearchNothing into a fallback response.

findings.title: Go SDK evaluation request and response shapes do not match the server
findings.observed: POST omitted knowledge_base_id and sent unsupported embedding_id. StartEvaluation returned an empty task ID, GetEvaluationResult discarded nested task/params/metric, and SDK string status did not model numeric statuses.
findings.fix: Align request and numeric task/progress/error/time fields; deserialize nested detail and typed retrieval/generation metrics; unwrap task for existing StartEvaluation return shape; reject malformed responses missing task IDs.
findings.compatibility: No in-repo callers depend on removed incorrect fields. Public struct changes are intentional API contract corrections; StartEvaluation/GetEvaluationResult method signatures are retained. Server exposes POST/GET only and no cancel endpoint; HTTP request context behavior is unchanged.

findings.title: Malformed Parquet dataset silently manufactures or overwrites evaluation relationships
findings.observed: Dangling explicit qrel/qas targets become empty text, duplicate IDs silently overwrite source text, conflicting qas picks the last answer, and missing/null ID columns project to zero and can join an unrelated zero-ID record.
findings.fix: Validate required scalar schema columns and physical types, reject null required values with a bounded row scan, validate unique text IDs and nonempty text, explicit reference targets, and conflicting qas. Allow identical duplicate relations and queries with absent relevance/answer labels.
findings.note: Initial exploratory missing-qrels/missing-qas rejection expectations were removed after review because Iterate intentionally supports unanswerable/unlabeled queries. Durable TestDatasetAllowsUnanswerableQueries protects that behavior.

findings.title: Evaluation indexes only qrel-linked passages, dropping unreferenced corpus distractors
findings.observed: A two-passage corpus containing relevant evidence and an unreferenced distractor indexed only the relevant passage.
findings.fix: Introduce EvaluationDataset and LoadDataset to supply QA pairs plus the full corpus. Sort corpus IDs without indexing arrays by ID; preserve distinct rows and all distractors. Evaluation validates pairs before indexing and retains cleanup behavior.
findings.tests: End-to-end evaluator fixture captures both indexed passages and verifies a first-ranked distractor produces precision and MRR .5.

coverage.lifecycle: Reviewed request detachment, errgroup peer cancellation, worker/background panic guards, pending/running/terminal persistence, scoped bounded cleanup, setup failures, empty datasets, cloning and cross-tenant result access. Existing lifecycle tests plus new malformed-dataset cleanup and tenant-scope tests used isolated temporary snapshots and stubs.
coverage.metrics: Reviewed all calculator implementations and tests. Existing precision/recall/NDCG/MAP duplicate behavior retained; hook remapping now preserves its required rank information. BLEU smoothing and ROUGE exclusive/tokenization conventions unchanged.
coverage.dataset_python: Reviewed sampling, lazy model initialization, checkpoints, answer-ID allocation and retries. Ran all dataset/tests in an isolated temporary venv using pytest/pandas/pyarrow/openai; no provider API contacted beyond existing localhost fake-server test.
coverage.frontend_api: Searched frontend/src/api and frontend/src/views for evaluation references; no dedicated evaluation UI/API client exists, only API capability labels. Reviewed backend handler, routes and tenant checks. SDK wire tests use a fixture matching handler EvaluationDetail JSON.

verification.result: Six storage resource-release test failures during parallel storage edits; no evaluation/dataset/metric failures. Root notified; root owns final full gate.

limits: No live deployment, database, external LLM/reranker or vector store used; evaluation integration tests use temporary Parquet files and injected service doubles.
Passage attribution remains the existing substring matching heuristic; identical or overlapping passage text across different IDs is inherently ambiguous without persisted origin metadata.
Datasets remain memory-resident; bounded validation scan adds no full copy but no large-corpus performance benchmark was run.
Metrics remain binary qrel relevance, not graded relevance; no change to the existing interpretation of optional score columns.
Full repository build/vet/test and final per-module commit are owned by root.
